page.notes: Left and right columns are read row by row, separated by " | " where the printed rows split between columns. The line "u" at the foot, left of the catchword, may be a signature mark; uncertain, not transcribed. Several Latin and Greek-free entries are set in a crowded small face: "sanctorum" and "reliquiæ" lines near the bottom left are partly rubbed. "Sancta sanctorū" may read "Sancta sanctorum" with final mark uncertain. The row "in sanctorum natalitijs 120.133" is printed as one entry across the gutter. "sus 139" is read as "sus" (possibly "fus"). The right column "scripta" may read "scripta" or "seripta"; read as printed. No page number printed.
